config.diagnostics.enable: Enable real-time KonadoScript syntax and semantic diagnostics.
config.projectIndex.enable: Index Godot text resources for completion, diagnostics, and navigation.
config.format.indentStyle: Indentation style used by the KonadoScript formatter.
config.format.indentSize: Number of spaces in one indentation level when space indentation is selected.
config.documentation.language: Documentation language. Auto follows the Visual Studio Code display language.
